Grace — thanks, and congrats on getting SOW across the line. Attaching a first-pass MAP and a lightweight canary checklist. High-level proposal below; the attached MAP_v1 has the detailed milestones and owners.

Summary proposal (first pass)
- Week 1 (Nov 29–Dec 3): Ops & admin training workshops (2 sessions, recorded)
- Week 2 (Dec 6–10): Limited integration and smoke tests against staging (E2E eval plan attached)
- Week 3 (Dec 13–17): Canary (2-day live window) on 5% traffic; monitoring and rollback gates
- Week 4 (Dec 20–24): Gradual ramp to 50% with follow-up evaluation; full cutover target Jan 4

Key asks for Elysian:
- Confirm training attendee list and preferred dates week of Nov 29 (we can shift earlier by one business day if needed)
- Approve canary window and rollback SLA (we propose automatic fallback to previous model variant on trigger thresholds)

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx, canary-checklist.xlsx

I'll loop Marcus for the migration/runbook details and Laura for enablement content.

-jasmine

Thanks for the draft, Jasmine. A couple of technical clarifications from the migration/runbook perspective:

- Canary sizing: we recommend starting with a 2-day window at 3–5% traffic but with an extended monitoring period (48 hrs post-window) before ramp decisions.
- Migration blackout: please confirm any Elysian maintenance windows (we should avoid Dec 14–15 based on prior notes).
- Capacity: we'll reserve dedicated capacity for the canary days, but need a firm estimate of peak concurrent sessions — can the Elysian infra team confirm expected session counts?
- Fallback: propose automatic fallback at 2x baseline error rate or 40% latency increase, whichever triggers first.

I made inline comments in MAP_v1 and added a short runbook excerpt to the canary-checklist. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to finalize thresholds.

-marcus
